messages:
maria: Customer POC hitting 413 / truncated context when sending full doc set. They bundle ~250k chars (~40k tokens). Body size ~9MB.
alex: Can you paste the exact curl request + headers? Also any gateway logs (X-Request-ID)?
maria: curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @payload.json https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate
maria: Response: HTTP/1.1 413 Request Entity Too Large
maria: We tried zipping payload.zip but their client can't unzip for the demo.
kyle: Customer wants to know if Dedicated increases limits or if we can flip a flag for the POC.
alex: Gateway default body limit is 6MB. We don't raise this globally for hosted. Immediate options:
- gzip the request (server accepts Content-Encoding)
- stream/chunk the payload and stitch on server
- move long docs to a vector DB and do RAG (preferred)
- local summarization to shrink prompt
alex: Example curl: curl -H 'Content-Encoding: gzip' --data-binary @payload.json.gz -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate
dinesh: Note: model token window is separate (eg 32k tokens). The 413 is right at the ingress. For a quick unblock gzip+chunking works.
dinesh: You can also use Transfer-Encoding: chunked to avoid buffering: curl -H 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked' --data-binary @payload.json ...
kyle: If we recommend RAG, what's the POC hit on latency and cost? Need a short blurb for customer.
alex: RAG adds retrieval latency (~50-200ms) and extra embedding costs. For POC we can limit to top-5 snippets and cheap embedding model; it's usually cheaper than paying for huge model context.
alex: Quick python gzip snippet:
```python
import gzip, requests
with open('payload.json','rb') as f:
  gz = gzip.compress(f.read())
  r = requests.post(url, data=gz, headers={'Content-Encoding':'gzip','Content-Type':'application/json','Authorization':'Bearer ...'})
  print(r.status_code, r.text)
```
maria: testing gzip now — reduces payload from 9MB -> 1.2MB. Request passed the gateway but model still trimmed the end of the doc (context > model window).
alex: If model truncation occurs, best practice: 1) RAG with top-k retrieval 2) document-level summarization + include summary in prompt 3) chunk content and run multiple queries and aggregate
deploy-bot: ingress-gateway/us-west-2: 413 observed for req=9f8a...; logged to ops
dinesh: For Dedicated we can raise per-tenant inbound limits and recommend a larger-context model variant (if they want raw full-doc). That carries infra+cost implications.
kyle: I'll propose two POC tracks: A) quick unblock: gzip + RAG (no infra change) B) enterprise: Dedicated + higher gateway limit + larger context model (longer lead + pricing)
maria: Sending customer recommended next steps: try gzip+RAG for demo; if they need raw context we'll discuss Dedicated.
alex: I'll spin up a KB note for Sales: 'POC large payloads — gzip, chunking, RAG, Dedicated options'
maria: thanks all, will update the customer after tests.
